images.filename: Archaeological Museum of Mykonos, Mykonos, Greece (53501272529).jpg
images.caption: Built in 1905, this Classical Revival-style building was designed by Alexandros Lykakis to house artifacts uncovered during an archaeological excavation of the circa 425 BC Purification Pit on the islet of Rineia (Rheneia), located close to Delos.  The building features a white stucco-clad exterior with decorative stone trim surrounds at the doors and windows, a chamfered parapet, and metal grilles on the windows.  The building was expanded in the 1930s, 1960s, and 1970s to its present size, and today remains in use as a museum.
